sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a young fox character. Draw this exact fox as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the orange fluffy body with its cream chest and belly, upright as in image 1, without head, without tail and without any legs: no legs, no shoulders, no thighs, no haunches and no paws drawn on it — one smooth rounded body; its top, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: the fox's head with its cream cheeks and black nose, facing right as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the nose and the rosy cheeks; without ears; its bottom edge rounded.
3. one ear: a pointed orange ear with cream fluff inside and a dark tip, with a rounded base.
4. one front leg: the front leg on the right of image 1 drawn whole, from the top of the shoulder to the paw: the rounded orange shoulder and upper arm, the elbow, and the forearm held up with its dark paw, as in image 1; its top is the full, smooth, rounded curve of the shoulder.
5. one hind leg: the near hind leg of image 1 drawn whole, from the top of the haunch to the foot: the big round orange thigh (the whole haunch, as big as it is in image 1), the dark lower leg and its dark foot; its top is the full, smooth, rounded curve of the haunch.
6. the tail: the big fluffy white-tipped tail, with a rounded base.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a young fox character; image 2 shows the same fox cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the fox's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the fox in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the fox's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: open in a bright happy grin, the inside pink.
7. the mouth closed in a small calm smile.
8. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
9. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
10. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

the fox crouches low with its tail up, wiggles, then pounces forward onto its front paws and pops back up with a grin.

animations.description: the fox swishes its big bushy tail from side to side.
the fox stretches its nose forward and sniffs, sniffs, sniffs the air.
the fox waves hello with one front paw.
the fox looks up, springs up and snaps its jaws at something just overhead, twice, then lands with a grin.
the fox tips its head and scratches its cheek with a front paw, eyes shut in bliss.
the fox curls round and tucks its nose into its big bushy tail, snug and cosy, then peeks out with a smile.

animations.description: the fox turns its head round to nibble at its own big tail, then spins right round after it.
the fox scrunches up its face, ah… ah… then sneezes with a jerk of its head, and blinks in surprise.
the fox swings its big bushy tail round to the front and curls it close, as if around a friend.
